OK this review isn't from an open world GTA junkie, this is more coming from a Mass Effect, Action RPG, cinematic games and Foreign film junkie specially Hong Kong films which i consider myself knowledgeable ( seen roughly over 1000 hong kong films in my life and probable over 1500 asian films in general ).
First on the basics, this is Graphically and gameplay wise probably a step below games like GTA, Read Dear redemption and I even dare say FPS like COD and island open world like Far Cry and Just Cause, but only because the driving it isn’t tight enough and you basically bump everything even when you try to do drive properly it just seems too loose while in other games  things flow better and in the graphics i will say that faces, and some of the locations are excellent but even with the HD texture pack download it is behind a few of the other, characters walk a bit funny and they blocky, compared to many even PS3 or Xbox games of the same type.
so we got the somewhat bad stuff out of the way. FIrst and most importantly, this game has one of the best crime/mob/gangster style storyline I have seen in a game, this could have been a pretty good jet Li or Donny Yen film about an undercover cop job gone wrong. The di8alogue is Excellent and I do mean excellent at no point not even the street vendors sound bad, they sound asian they sound exactly like when Asian people speak English, I also want to point out that obviously there is a bit of Westernization of the story but its very little and to me it felt a more genuine take on East meets West story than almost anything Hollywood has done including Rush Hour movies and most Jet Li western movies. if This gets made into a movie don’t be surprised.
The Gameplay I mentioned earlier about the driving, yes that part frustrated me as Driving is a large part of what you do in this game but despite that I have to say most of the Plata forming ( jumping obstacles ) fighting and shooting is excellent is as if somebody got a bit a  tiny bit of Assassins Creed a bit of Uncharted in the shooting and a large amount of Batman's Arkahm Asylum and City and I do mean a large amount since this game is essentially the same fighting system as Batman, Considering that those 3 games i Mentioned are pretty popular I would say this is a good thing. while not a master of any of those it holds well and I personally love variety, also forgot to mention the Just Cause 2 jumping on vehicle and hijacking also adds a bit of the action.
I have to compliment the sound team of this game not only was the Cantonese music very authentic ( I kind of recognized a few of the artist but am not a 100% sure ) the combination of rock and pop and everything between was very cool, British DJ makes sense since HK still has a lot of British ties and the mix of English and Cantonese is very authentic. Voice over even in the Cantonese aspect ( which I can understand a little bit ) was very good nothing looked forced everything flowed even the English to Cantonese which Winston would use often.
The extra stuff is solid, cant say I was interested in♥♥♥♥♥♥fighting and I didn’t even attempt it, but the mahjong like game was cool, the steal cars and hijack money trucks could get repetitive but adds content and the first few times is very cool specially the bank car getting away from the cops. The Dates are sadly short lived and hopefully in future game we will have a change to actually keep our favorite but still the change of pace was welcomed and we actually cared about some of the girls not simply some passing the time thing some of them actually seemed interesting. Doing random stuff for strangers for Face points was actually pretty cool, since most missions had added humor to them.
this is a solid 8.5 8.9  possibly, only because of the light driving, a bit outdated physical models on the characters and a few glitches ( couldn’t get to a parking lot one time to turn a car in had to forfeit the mission happened like 2 times. )
a sequel of this game can be a 9.5 easily top of the line GTA competitor. They need to simply improve the engine, add a few more locales like MACAU, Changzhou or maybe even Shanghai ( although with the communist regime I doubt too many triads if any in Shanghai but it would make a nice change of pace to have a mission or two there ) IT would be cool if you can keep a Girlfriend for the duration of the game, with advantages and disadvantages of having a loved one while being a member of a triad or undercover, Karma points would be a cool addition specially since Karma is very popular in Asia in general the concept would fit the theme, having your character becoming ruthless gangster or becoming a Folk Hero ( like a modern, IP man, Wong Fei Hong ) also it would be nice to have different fighting styles, this game focused on Street fighting and had a very UFC style to the moves ( Georges Saint Pierre added the motion ) but it would be nice ( since this is fantasy anyways ) to have maybe some Tiger, Crane, Drunker, monkey etc. a little bit just the moves that would look good in a street fight or as optional. also using the environment was excellent more environment usage would be great.
I think This IP has promise they just have to keep on this same path, improved engine more of everything and keep taking inspiration from the heavily underappreciated but excellent Hong Kong and Asian action cinema.

Blackwake would be a fun game in a more mature and coordinating environment. However arming the cannons by inserting gunpowder, cannon balls then ramming and pushing the cannons starts to remove the satisfaction of firing them as you’re required to perform this tedious task over and over again, and even then somebody else could fire the cannon you spent time prepping before you.
As coordination within your crew is essential all players must work together for a victory, however more often than not 50% or more of the crew spent most their time firing the same cannon and refusing to move to perform more important tasks.
The heavy requirement of communication makes VOIP a very useful feature. This is negated by the continuous insults and racial remarks by immature players shouting down the microphone. If you manage to block everybody that is doing this, you’re still in a game where the ships names display the words / phrases you didn’t want to hear over VOIP.
The overall performance was good with a few bugs throughout which didn’t break the gameplay.
There was an issues with the UI not changing upon exiting the interaction with the object, which happened a few times, one of which was the “Pumping” overlay permanently being displayed on the screen. Alongside UI Issues that would display menu’s behind current UI rendering them unusable.
The gun and melee mechanics felt clunky at the best of times. You’re unable to see how / where your shots are after being fired which prevents you from knowing how you need to adjust your aim for the next shot. Combined with lack of emphasis when successfully hitting a target, removed any sense of reward and left an empty feeling resulting in the gunplay feeling dull.
Blackwake has the potential to be a great game. However it’s let down by tedious and clunky mechanics, immature / toxic players and a lack of progression, with no end goal in sight.

Overall i can recomend this game. I relly enjoyed the graphics, and never have I herd about a "comand and concor" like game that actually has plannets. The variety of units is great, but just mass producing flame or standard tanks can never fail. The campain is pretty good, it doesnt have a story behind it. Instead you begin with controlling one planet and slowly take over the galaxy. Playing through the campain usually takes about 2 - 4 hours depedning on how large the galaxy is and how powerful the enemies are. I have not played very many games of multiplayer matches, but the games that i have played  were simmilar to campaign games.
If i were to give a complaint about Titans it would probubly be the effectiveness of plannet destroying weapons. They feel too powerful, however it takes a great deel of resources and time to create one. Plus it does feel great to throw two plannets into each other.
If you ever wanted to get into ROTMG or start playing again now would be the time.
